# WizeLife — Nomad Tax Data Verification Packet

**Date prepared:** 2026-05-28
**Prepared by:** WizeLife (auto-generated from production data)

## 📋 Cover Letter

**Dear Reviewer,**

WizeLife (wizelife.ai) is an Israeli consumer-facing tax-info platform. The page **wizelife.ai/p/digital-nomad.html** lets Israeli remote workers check how many days they can stay in 15 popular destinations before triggering personal tax residency, and the risk that their Israeli employer faces creating a Permanent Establishment (PE) there.

The page is **currently set to noindex** pending your review. It will not surface in Google until you sign off.

**What we need from you:**
1. Verify each fact in the per-country tables below. Tick ✓ correct, ✗ wrong (with correction), or ❓ unsure.
2. Answer the 7 specific red-flag questions on page 18.
3. Sign the acceptance page (page 19). This gives us your professional opinion that the data is suitable for general informational use (NOT personal advice).

**Disclaimer text we already show on every page:** *"⚠️ מידע כללי — אמת אצל יועץ מס לפני החלטה / General info — verify with a tax advisor before any decision."*

## 🗺️ Page Snapshot — what users see

- Big number: "Max safe days = MIN(personal-tax-resident threshold, PE-risk threshold)"
- 4-zone day axis: 🟢 tourist-safe → 🟡 PE risk → 🔴 close to tax-resident → ⛔ tax-resident
- Country grid: 15 countries with their max-safe number
- Israel-side residency check: 4 questions → "are you still an Israeli tax resident?"
- Multi-country split planner
- PE mitigations (employer-of-record, contractor, local entity)
- FAQ (8 items)

Live URL (noindex): https://wizelife.ai/p/digital-nomad.html
